title: Completing the Square Method
text:
To complete the square for $$x^2 - 6x$$:
1. Take half the coefficient of x: $$\frac{-6}{2} = -3$$
2. Square it: $$(-3)^2 = 9$$
3. Add and subtract 9

$$x^2 - 6x + 9 = (x-3)^2$$

title: Complete Square for y
text:
To complete the square for $$y^2 + 4y$$:
1. Take half the coefficient of y: $$\frac{4}{2} = 2$$
2. Square it: $$2^2 = 4$$
3. Add and subtract 4

$$y^2 + 4y + 4 = (y+2)^2$$
